article.body:
Kintsugi-VLA paper lacks a documented physical robot demonstration

Kintsugi-VLA is an arXiv research paper dated 28 September 2026, but the supplied record does not identify a robot performing a specific task in a physical environment. No joint count, degrees of freedom, end-effector design, payload, actuator specification or other physical-system details are provided. The title describes turning failed robot rollouts into recovery data through “interventional recoverability,” but the record does not establish whether those rollouts came from teleoperation, simulation, autonomous operation or another training method. No warehouse, factory, home or outdoor test is documented, and no object count, trial count, success rate or physical performance result is available.
